title: Deeper/broader unknown nested TABLE parity and loss-reporting review
mode: primary-source web research and read-only plan refinement
scope: Compare the DXF TABLES contract with current open-source parser/writer structures
Separate unknown nested symbol tables from ACAD_TABLE entities, custom classes, and malformed bare TABLE recovery
Resolve PAR-36/7U toward bounded, observable skip behavior without introducing a generic retention API
Specify fast generated validation and bounded diagnostic overflow behavior

method.kind: Read primary Autodesk references, current project source/docs and issues, then inspect local parser/diagnostic paths
method.limitations: Autodesk sources define the published standard table set but do not prove vendor-specific table names cannot occur. Peer source/issues were reviewed, not executed. No representative producer drawing for an unknown nested table was available, so the plan explicitly declines generic preservation claims.

sources.observed: The standard TABLES section documents APPID, BLOCK_RECORD, DIMSTYLE, LAYER, LTYPE, STYLE, UCS, VIEW, and VPORT, with TABLE header, records, ENDTAB, and ENDSEC framing. Group 70 is a maximum/allocation hint rather than an exact record count. The separate graphical TABLE entity is ACAD_TABLE with entity-specific subclasses and cell payload.

The TABLES implementation exposes a fixed mapping of standard table names to explicit collections and serializes those collections; the reviewed path shows no generic opaque symbol-table writer. The XREF/cross-document operation separately lists ACAD_TABLE and preserved unknown tag-storage entities/objects as unsupported/ignored. That operation-specific behavior is not evidence about base parsing or same-document rewriting.

sources.revision: Open feature request opened 2026-06-30; page reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The requested recovery handles a bare TABLE token outside a SECTION/TABLES wrapper in some older NC/CAM/plotting exports. It is not a request about unknown nested table names, and the issue contains no public input drawing. It remains a separate nonstandard compatibility lead.

The unknown-type discussion concerns application-defined DWG classes and opaque object bytes, with retention dependent on class/profile and in some cases same-version rewrite with a complete unknown bit blob. This is not equivalent to a DXF group-pair symbol table.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw and LibreCAD adapter paths
sources.observed: dxfRW::processTables consumes an unrecognized nested table through ENDTAB and rejects ENDSEC first. OperationDiagnostic can carry non-failing secondary entries but is capped at 16; dx_iface snapshots the read diagnostic. The plan does not claim that every frontend currently presents advisories.

assessment.existingDecisionResolved: PAR-36/7U now prefers a bounded, observable skip for well-framed nested unknown symbol tables; arbitrary retention is deferred until a named consumer and valid producer evidence justify it.
assessment.planImpact: Clarifies format/peer boundaries; makes loss reporting and diagnostic-cap overflow explicit; specifies generated ASCII and safely typed Binary DXF tests, malformed terminator controls, following-known-table sentinel, adapter diagnostic snapshot check, and the existing focused-test cadence.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep nested unknown symbol tables, ACAD_TABLE graphical entities, custom CLASS/PROXY objects, and bare TABLE outside TABLES as separate behaviors.
Do not use group 70 as an exact body count; skip only to ENDTAB, reject malformed termination, and retain forward-progress checks.
Use a non-failing TABLES-phase unsupported-table-skipped advisory; when the 16-entry secondary budget is exceeded, expose a bounded aggregate count and detail-truncation outcome.

Generate the positive and malformed inputs locally; cover repeated tags, app data, XDATA, handle groups, and a following known table in ASCII, with Binary DXF only where group widths are already recognized.
Verify the adapter snapshots the advisory, but do not claim a CLI warning unless the actual frontend presents it.
Run the focused generated selector and owning DXF-fixture/hardening CTest only; no peer runtime, full suite, external fixture, dependency, or new CTest registration is needed for the leaf.

workingTree.reason: This was a research and plan-only update in a broadly modified shared worktree; no code/test changes were made and no unrelated changes were staged.
